Huawei Cloud Partner Scout 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides Huawei Cloud BSS partner-scope read-only queries using the huaweicloudsdkbss SDK.
- Supports customer lists, balances, account flows, indirect partners, coupon quotas, coupons, customer bills, resources, orders, and refunds.
- Strictly refuses any write, pay, refund, create, update, or grant operations.
- Fixed endpoint (bss.myhuaweicloud.com) and region (cn-north-1); only for authenticated partner accounts.
- Only reads AK/SK credentials from environment variables; does not interact with any credential files.
- Integrates quality reporting (optional) with configurable reporting endpoints and environment variables.
